tasks.spec:
You are extending a small billed-smoke tool (offline until a human confirms) in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: scripts/ringer/environment_narration/smoke_direct.py and tests/test_environment_smoke_direct.py (read both first). Never edit anything else (screen.py stays untouched). You never make a live call. NEVER print, log or write any credential value.

GOAL: a wider 70B-only run. Defaults must stay byte-for-byte what they are today (default variants, original 6-slot plan, json_object mode).

CHANGE, TESTS FIRST:
1. New CLI option `--slots original|wide` (default original). `original` is the current _SLOT_ORDER. `wide` is exactly this ordered list of (start, context, sample), per variant, round-robin interleaved across variants as today: S1 proposed 0,1,2; S1 existing 0; S2 proposed 0,1,2; S2 existing 0; S3 proposed 0,1; S4 proposed 0,1; S5b proposed 0,1,2; S5b existing 0,1; S6 proposed 0,1,2 = 20 slots. _build_plan takes the slot list; the --max-calls guard and --max-usd ceiling guard stay.
2. Derived start `S5b`: when loading the prompts document, build prompts['S5b'] from prompts['S5'] (both contexts, system and user) by deleting every line of the user text that contains the phrase 'may say this aloud' (the authored reveal cue; match the whole line including its leading '- ', and its trailing newline). Fail with a clear ValueError if either context of S5 has no such line. Everything else byte-identical to S5. Do not alter prompts['S5'] and do not change anything in the prompts file on disk. `S5b` is only reachable through --slots wide (the original slots still use S5).
3. New profile appended after the existing eight (not in the default four): label `llama-3.3-70b-schema`, model_id `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast`, token_parameter max_tokens, max_tokens 1024, extra_body {}, input_price 0.293, output_price 2.253, note 'constrains the reply with response_format json_schema'. A profile key `response_schema` (dict, default absent) makes _request_body send `response_format = {"type": "json_schema", "json_schema": <that dict>}` instead of json_object (Cloudflare's documented shape: the schema sits directly under `json_schema`, not wrapped in name/schema). The schema for this profile, verbatim: {"type":"object","properties":{"segments":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["narration","dialogue","action"]},"text":{"type":"string"}},"required":["kind","text"]}},"selected_knowledge_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"item_facts":{"type":"object"}},"required":["segments"]}. Deep-copy it per request. temperature 0 stays. Profiles without response_schema are unchanged.
4. Cloudflare may return the schema-constrained answer as an object at `result.response` (a dict, not a string). _extract_text must then return json.dumps(that dict, ensure_ascii=False) as the final text with path 'result.response(object)'; string responses behave exactly as today. The row's usable/narration logic then works on that text as for any reply.
5. Report: the per-variant summary also prints 'Valid JSON: X / N' (the same count as Usable, labelled for clarity is NOT needed; skip if redundant) and, for runs whose rows carry more than one start, a per-start usable count line `By start: S1 a/b, S2 c/d, ...` in sorted start order. Existing 24-row and 6-row reports must still render unchanged except for this one new line when more than one start appears (acceptable: the original 24-row report gains the line).
6. Tests (hermetic): default plan unchanged (4 variants, 24 calls); `--slots wide --variants llama-3.3-70b-nojson` yields 20 calls with exactly the slot list above in order and a ceiling equal to the sum of per-call ceilings; two variants give 40 interleaved calls; S5b texts contain no 'may say this aloud' while S5 still does and S5b differs from S5 only by that line; ValueError when the cue line is missing; the schema body has response_format.type == 'json_schema' with json_schema equal to the schema dict and the module constant not mutated; the nojson body still has no response_format; _extract_text on an object result.response; unknown --slots rejected. FINISH: ruff check and ruff format both files; run screen.py --dry then smoke_direct.py --dry --slots wide --variants llama-3.3-70b-nojson,llama-3.3-70b-schema with dummy env values; report calls and ceiling USD.

a=json.load(open('/tmp/env-wide-plan.json'))['calls'];b=json.load(open('/tmp/env-wide-plan24.json'))['calls']
